metric_definitions.EPE: Mean Euclidean endpoint error over one-to-one matches to next-frame Shi-Tomasi detections within the same radius.
metric_definitions.track_lifetime: Consecutive APS interval boundaries with a successful match, summed in interval duration; proxy, not identity ground truth.
metric_definitions.features_successfully_tracked: Mean one-to-one reference-matched features per APS interval.
metric_definitions.failure_rate: 1 - total successful matches / (initial feature count * interval count).
metric_definitions.processing_time: Summed per-interval method time plus identical Shi-Tomasi initialization/reference-detection cost, excluding data load and plotting.
metric_definitions.update_latency: Frame-only reports per-pair KLT call; event systems report per-event association/update-loop time, including rejects.
metric_definitions.events_per_useful_update: Event systems: total event samples / successful endpoint matched feature-intervals; frame-only: N/A.
metric_definitions.state_updates: Frame-only: successful KLT coordinate updates; event systems: successful alpha-beta state updates.
metric_definitions.track_segment: A single contiguous APS segment; features start once in frame k and are not replenished.
metric_definitions.hybrid_correction: After evaluation, each one-to-one matched state snaps x/y to its reference corner and timestamp to APS time; velocity/confidence are preserved; unmatched states are unchanged.
metric_definitions.event_driven_evaluation: APS references are used only by the evaluator and do not correct or alter event-driven state.
